research_question: Does exclusion of an admissible distinction generate residue, and do sufficiency, necessity, or biconditional relations survive in the bounded model?

hypotheses.primary: Residue is generated if and only if a projection excludes at least one admissible distinction.
hypotheses.null: Exclusion and residue are not equivalent under the operational definitions.
hypotheses.interpretation_rule: Any exclusion-without-residue case falsifies sufficiency; any residue-without-exclusion case falsifies necessity.

interpretation_protocol: report weak and strong admissibility separately
treat surviving relations as bounded model results only
do not infer ontological causation from association
